description: The DDO photometric system is an intermediate-band filter set (m35, m38, m41, m42, m45, m48) established for stellar classification, surface gravity, and metallicity determination of G and K late-type stars.
short_description: DDO intermediate-band system (Mann & von Braun 2015 and ADPS)
facility_description: The David Dunlap Observatory (DDO) in Richmond Hill, Ontario, was the optical research observatory of the University of Toronto Department of Astronomy and Astrophysics.
notes: The DDO system was developed by McClure & van den Bergh (1968) and standardized by McClure (1976). The ADPS band variations are compiled in the Asiago Database on Photometric Systems (Moro & Munari 2000). No specific digital redistribution license is stated on the archived observatory page.
